Description: Planned contrasts of face expectation against the other predictors for the facedetection task, for the single-feature and the unique model.

statistics.Description: Labels of the four statistics, in the order of the other arrays: 'contrast vs mean of others' = delta(face expectation) - mean delta of the other features; 'contrast vs max of others' = delta(face expectation) - largest delta of the other features; 'face expectation delta > 0' = delta(face expectation); 'mean delta of others < 0' = mean delta of the other features. delta is noise-corrected predictivity in the preview minus the no-preview condition.

observed_single.Description: Observed value of each statistic, from single-feature predictivity.

p_single.Description: Permutation p of each statistic, one-sided in the direction given by its label (greater for the first three, less for the last). Null: the two condition means are exchanged for a random subset of images and the cross-validation rerun, with both pseudo-conditions noise-corrected by the average of the two reliabilities; 5000 permutations. For observed_single.

observed_unique.Description: Observed value of each statistic, from unique predictivity (the eight other features of the full model).

p_unique.Description: Permutation p of each statistic, one-sided in the direction given by its label (greater for the first three, less for the last). Null: the two condition means are exchanged for a random subset of images and the cross-validation rerun, with both pseudo-conditions noise-corrected by the average of the two reliabilities; 5000 permutations. For observed_unique.
